findings.detail: Submit seals only request.workspace_ref and discards the authorized binding value. Start reads binding.RealPath, commits, then passes that old string into the driver. BeforeResume re-enters harnessGate, but workspace() only validates the current binding and discards it; there is no comparison with the exact path/revision already supplied to the suspended child. A still-authorized changed binding under the same ref can validate while the old source path is resumed. Production constructor currently remains UNVERIFIED, so this is a latent path-binding gap, not a claim that an unauthorized real child has run.
findings.fix_required: After current test scope reaches terminal, create Host-owned immutable binding ref/revision/canonical path digest snapshot in new sealed input; compare current authority/binding to it at admission, scan, launch and BeforeResume, and explicitly tie BeforeResume to the exact binding/path passed to driver. Reject legacy input lacking snapshot for new execution; keep historical Get/List/read paths compatible.
findings.author_response: Author independently acknowledged current gap and intends fix only after test01 terminal.

findings.detail: Given a present/config-controlled/logged-in descriptor without descriptor.UnavailableReason and matching canonical identity, snapshot State READY plus Reason PERMISSION_PROFILE_UNAVAILABLE returns READY. Reason is checked only when snapshot.State==UNAVAILABLE. This admits a contradictory readiness snapshot despite the frozen any-unavailable-reason fail-closed contract. Current ordinary production constructor returns UNVERIFIED and no external READY route was found.
findings.fix_required: READY must also require an empty snapshot.Reason; reject nonempty/contradictory readiness reasons consistently, with narrow trusted fake-provider table cases after test01 ends.

observations: Exact global windows.sandbox="mxc" occurs once in the canonical argument builder; no profile-prefixed sandbox key remains. Root prior-mode-key correction is acknowledged without recounting its existing diagnostic.

Canonical requested policy identity hashes the same argument builder using Host cwd/source placeholders; it is not claimed to measure effective managed permissions. Full identity equality is checked against fresh descriptor/snapshot by the shared predicate.

Capabilities/Submit/scan/runHarness/BeforeResume and driver Start use the common readiness helper. Driver rechecks before cb.BeforeResume while launchWithCallback has created a suspended child; ResumeThread occurs only on nil callback error. This is source inspection, not independently verified process-stop evidence.

NewCodexCLI rejects PermissionOverrides and returns UNVERIFIED. NewCodexCLIForTrustedGoTest is selected only in Go tests among reviewed apps/internal/adapters call sites; actual Host uses ordinary NewCodexCLI. No external JSON/env/HTTP READY selector found.
Public capability verification values remain UNVERIFIED and enforcement_verified=false; public profile_id remains codex-workspace-read-v1, with no added public DTO field observed.

Native sealed sandbox/command/policy v2 fields are checked during reuse/admission/dispatch and against current policy in launch gate. History reader harnessTaskInput is currently independent of current readiness. Fix must preserve that history separation.

Existing test source has a readiness mutation-before-resume case and canonical global-key argv assertions. Coverage still needs field-wise stale policy/READY+reason and same-ref binding changes, plus legacy history-preserving rejection. No tests were executed or declared successful by this reviewer.
